Prepare to jump back to Republic territory.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]|''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]''}} The ''Resolute'' was assigned to Anakin Skywalker's [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]], and it served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of Skywalker under the [[Admiral/Legends|admiralty]] of [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]. Other qualified [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were authorized to command the ship, such as [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi Generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and even Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. ===Christophsis engagements=== {{Main|Battle of Christophsis/Legends}} {{Quote|Stand by to break orbit - Separatist vessels incoming. Sorry, General Kenobi, but we're under fire - you're on your own.|[[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Admiral Yularen]], withdrawing Jedi cruiser ''Resolute'' from [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] orbit|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]}} [[File:Kaliida_Shoals.jpg|thumb|left|210px|The ''Resolute'' shortly before receiving the task of delivering Ahsoka Tano]] In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' the naval forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] blockaded the resource rich world of Christophsis, trapping a relief effort to the planet organized by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. In a vain effort to help the esteemed Senator, Anakin Skywalker launched an assault on the [[Christophsis blockade/Legends|Christophsis blockade]] with two other ''Venator''-class ships and three [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|supply ships]]. However, the Republic forces were severely outnumbered, and a direct order from the newly arrived [[High Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] resulted in the retreat of the ''Resolute'' and its battle group to a safe position behind the [[Christophsis's moon/Legends|moon]] of the planet. Anakin then flew over to Kenobi's flagship, the [[Negotiator/Legends|''Negotiator'']],{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode216.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cat and Mouse}} where he was given orders to sneak past the blockade in a prototype [[Stealth ship/Legends|stealth ship]] and deliver supplies. Shortly after, Skywalker successfully destroyed [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]], commander of the blockade, and Kenobi resumed the assault on the disorganized blockade. During the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], the ''Resolute'' was tasked with delivering [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] in a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|Republic attack shuttle]] safely to [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Later, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] relayed a message through the ''Resolute'' to request reinforcements on [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]. Upon fulfilling its primary objective, the ''Resolute'' was forced to withdraw from the planetary orbit, leaving the ground forces on their own. ===The ''Malevolence'' crisis=== {{Main|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends}}
[[File:Btlbywing.png|thumb|left|250px|[[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing fighters]] depart the ''Resolute''.]]
During the hunt for a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] "mystery weapon," Anakin and Ahsoka lost contact with Plo Koon after his fleet was [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|attacked]] by the weapon. They departed the ''Resolute'' and took the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']] in search for any survivors of Plo Koon's fleet. After rescuing Plo Koon, [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]], [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker]] and [[Boost/Legends|Boost]], the only survivors of the battle, they discovered the enormous [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], and narrowly escaped a wave from its [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] and returned to the ''Resolute''. Anakin then planned to use a strike force of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] on a counterattack on the massive vessel, which was planning to attack an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|medical center]] tending over 50,000 wounded clones. Anakin, Ahsoka and Plo Koon, along with [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]], departed the ''Resolute'' and took a shortcut through the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]], where they encountered [[Neebray/Legends|Neebray mantas]]. The ''Malevolence'' then arrived, and after losing almost half their squadron, Ahsoka managed to convince Anakin to change the plan, and he finally changed the target from the bridge of the ''Malevolence'' to its ion cannons. When the ship attempted to use its damaged ion cannons on the medical center, they exploded and caused further damage to the ship. The ''Resolute'', the [[Negotiator/Legends|''Negotiator'']] and another [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] then arrived in the system and started to attack the ''Malevolence''. After [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] captured [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] aboard the ship, Anakin and Obi-Wan went to rescue her. They were successful, and Anakin also managed to reprogram the ship's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]], causing it to crash into the [[Dead Moon of Antar/Legends|Dead Moon of Antar]]. ===Battle at Rishi Station=== {{Main|Battle of the Rishi moon}} [[File:EchoFivesHonored-Rookies.png|thumb|left|220px|Echo and Fives honored in the Resolute's hangar shortly after the battle]] Weeks later, Grievous dispatched [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] to destroy an [[Rishi Station/Legends|outpost]] on the [[Rishi moon]]. When [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] arrived for a scheduled inspection, they were [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|attacked]] by the droids, but managed to destroy the station and alert the Republic with the help of [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], [[Echo/Legends|Echo]] and [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]], the survivors of the first attack that took most of the clones' lives. The ''Resolute'' arrived along with several other ''Venator''-class cruisers and was able to drive off the Separatist fleet intent on destroying [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. ===Battle of Bothawui=== {{Main|Battle of Bothawui/Legends}}
[[File:ReportFromFalleen-DOAD.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Anakin, Ahsoka and Captain Rex talk to Obi-Wan after the battle]]
Anakin and Ahsoka left the ''Resolute'' in search of R2-D2, who had gone missing in a [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|battle]]. The two Jedi were unsuccessful in locating a hidden Artoo aboard a [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|scavenger ship]], unaware that Artoo had already been promised to Grievous by [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]]. Ahsoka and Rex then left to rescue Anakin, who had been scouting ahead when his tracking beacon was accidentally activated and alerted several [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]] to his position. They then located a Separatist [[Skytop Station/Legends|listening post]], and were able to [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|destroy]] it as well as rescue R2-D2. ===Capture of Dooku=== After Anakin went aboard a ''Munificent''-class frigate to [[Skirmish at Vanqor/Legends|locate and capture]] [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]], Obi-Wan joined him. The ''Resolute'', under command of Ahsoka, then arrived to reinforce them. However, Dooku escaped and the two Jedi followed him, but both the Jedi and Dooku crash-landed on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]]. Dooku was taken captive by [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]] and taken to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], while Ahsoka arrived to rescue Obi-Wan and Anakin. From the ''Resolute'', Anakin and Obi-Wan were dispatched by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to confirm that the pirates were holding Dooku captive so a deal could be struck between the Republic and the pirates. However, Anakin and Obi-Wan were taken captive as well, but managed to [[Mission to Florrum/Legends|escape]]. ===Battle of Quell=== {{Main|Sky Battle of Quell}} [[File:Resolute_hyperspace.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Resolute'' travels through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to go to the aid of Aayla Secura's fleet.]] The ''Resolute'' came to the aid of Jedi General [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and her fleet when they were [[Sky Battle of Quell|attacked]] by four [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]]. The ''Resolute'' arrived in time to launch three [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] to board Secura's flagship, the [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']], and extract all Republic personnel. [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|Rocket droids]] took notice of the new arrivals and were distracted enough to break off and intercept them. However, the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] commander, already impatient, commanded the ships to destroy the cruiser. A [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class]] [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|frigate]] arrived for the evacuation, but a raging inferno rushed through the ship, and Anakin sacrificed himself, using [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|hold back]] the fire, but was still severely injured. Ahsoka and Aayla managed to get him aboard the frigate, but as it started to dock to the ''Resolute'', its hyperdrive was accidentally activated from an assault by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]]. Fortunately, the ''Resolute'' managed to maneuver out of the way and avoided being taken into hyperspace with the frigate. Yularen ordered his men to finish the battle before plotting a course to search for the Jedi. Ahsoka, Aayla and Anakin later avoided hitting a star, but crash-landed on [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. They were able to find medical help for Anakin from the planet's [[Lurmen/Legends|inhabitants]], and were also able to [[Defense of Maridun/Legends|thwart]] the development of a [[Defoliator/Legends|new Separatist weapon]]. Admiral Yularen was apparently able to locate the Jedi on his own, as the ''Resolute'', along with two other ''Venator''-class cruisers, arrived on Maridun to pick up the Jedi. ===Battle of Ryloth=== {{Main|Battle of Ryloth/Legends}} [[File:Breaking_Ryloth_blockade.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Resolute'' advances toward the Separatist blockade and angles its hull forward.]] When the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and its [[Twi'lek/Legends|inhabitants]] were enslaved by [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] Leader [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], the ''Resolute,'' along with the [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']] and [[Redeemer/Legends|''Redeemer'']], took part in a plan to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|liberate]] the planet by first cutting through the Separatist blockade, so that the invasion forces could land. Ahsoka led a squadron for the first time, leading [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)]] as [[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]]. After she cut a path to the [[Procurer|lead ship]], Separatist reinforcements arrived, but Ahsoka disobeyed a direct order from both Admiral Yularen and Anakin to retreat. The ''Resolute'' was then pummeled by suicidal Vulture droids, which were too numerous for the gunners to shoot down, and one droid rammed itself into the bridge, severely injuring Admiral Yularen. Ahsoka then retreated, but lost half her battle group along the way. The ''Resolute'' and [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']] retreated to hyperspace, but the [[Redeemer/Legends|''Redeemer'']] was destroyed. [[File:ResoluteDefender-SoR.png|thumb|250px|The ''Resolute'' alongside the ''Defender'' during the battle.]] After consoling his Padawan, Anakin then devised a plan to ram the ''Defender'' into the lead ship, leaving only outmaneuver-able droids in charge of the blockade. All of the ''Defender''{{'s}} supplies, starfighters, and shuttles were transferred to the ''Resolute'', and Anakin proceeded to take the ''Defender'' back to Ryloth with [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] aboard. Ahsoka, made more confident from the support of Admiral Yularen, planned to [[Marg Sabl/Legends|angle]] the ''Resolute'' so that its hull would face toward the blockade and act as a screen for the fighters to launch and destroy the blockade. After Anakin succeeded in crashing the ''Defender'' into the lead control ship, the ''Resolute'' emerged from hyperspace and maneuvered according to the plan. Ahsoka then led a squadron of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing fighters]] and [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrents]], and she was able to successfully eliminate the Separatist blockade. Rex, meanwhile, dispatched a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to retrieve Anakin's [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. ===Hunt for the missing holocron=== {{Main|Battle of Devaron/Legends}} [[File:BattleOfDevaron-CoD.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Resolute'' battles Separatist frigates over Devaron]] After [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|stole a Jedi holocron]], he went to the planet [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] in order to kidnap [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] who had the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], which contained a list of all Force-sensitives in the galaxy. While Bane attempted to escape, the ''Resolute'' attacked [[Cad Bane's Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Bane's frigate]]. In an attempt to save Ropal and reclaim the holocron, Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano and Captain Rex led a number of clones and three AT-TEs in an assault on the ship. At the conclusion of the battle, Cad Bane killed clone trooper [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] and hid on the ''Resolute'' after the Jedi's escape. He then used a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] from the hangar and a hyperspace ring to escape. ===Battle over Saleucami=== {{Main|Battle of Saleucami/Legends}} Later on the Resolute along with three [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|Charger c70 retrofits]], an [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|''Arquitens''-class light cruiser]], an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator-I'' class assault ship]] and two other ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] were sent to [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] to distract Grievous' fleet while [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] crept aboard and rescued Jedi Master [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]], who had been [[Capture of Eeth Koth/Legends|kidnapped]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The ''Resolute'' provided supporting fire until the enemy ships were eliminated. Admiral Yularen was forced to wait in orbit while General Kenobi led a hunt for Grievous on the planet's surface. When the Kaleesh General escaped the trap set for him, the ''Resolute'' tried to intercept his shuttle, yet was unable to prevent the General from escaping once again. ===Taloraan maneuvers=== {{Main|Mission to Taloraan}} {{Quote|''Resolute'', this is Kenobi! You're flying into a trap! Do you read?!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|''[[The Clone Wars: The Wind Raiders of Taloraan]]''}} The ''Resolute'' participated in the [[Battle over Kothlis]], which resulted in a Republic victory. After a diplomatic error by Padawan Ahsoka Tano forced the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] to declare their neutrality, this ship escorted several Jedi and a fleet of smaller ships to the world of [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]]. The planet's [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] mines were of the utmost importance to the war effort. Once in orbit, Admiral Yularen detected strong magnetic fields, which prevented communication. General Kenobi ordered the ship to maintain a safe distance while the Jedi were negotiating down on [[Taloraan City]]. However, the negotiations were a ruse propagated by [[Magister]] [[Orlin Denache]], who was working with Count Dooku and the Separatist Alliance. In fact, droid forces had landed in Taloraan City, and a ''Munificent''-class frigate was hiding in the clouds. The Jedi discovered the treachery when their shuttle was destroyed and they were captured. Having subsequently been freed by [[Sech Govlinder]], the Jedi warned the ''Resolute'' moments before it was drawn into the trap. The ship descended into the atmosphere and fired on the hidden ''Munificent'', taking down the frigate's rear shields and destroying its engines, dooming the ship to descend to the planet's core. With their situation untenable, the remaining Separatists were routed and the treaty was signed. ===Destruction=== [[File:ResoluteDestroyed-Nightsisters.png|thumb|left|220px|The destruction of the ''Resolute'']] {{Main|Battle of Sullust/Legends}} During the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|Battle of Sullust]] the ''Resolute'' was attacked by [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|tri-fighters]] led by [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. Ventress ordered half of her fighters to disable the port side shield generators of the already weakened cruiser, while she went for the bridge. She maneuvered through the hail of defensive blaster fire and, once the port side shield generators were destroyed, she flew in between the cruiser's two bridges and poured laser fire into them. The entire cruiser was engulfed in flames, though Admiral Yularen and the majority of the crew managed to escape. With the loss of the ''Resolute'', Anakin transferred his command to another cruiser. ==Behind the scenes== There has been much confusion to the ''Resolute''{{'s}} first appearance in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film novelization]], which stated that it was present for the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]] under Admiral Yularen's command. ''The Clone Wars'' novel takes place before and was also published prior to [[The Clone Wars: Wild Space|''Wild Space'']], during which the Star Destroyer's commission and maiden voyage is featured. The ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'', released in [[2009]], further complicates the matter by stating that the ''Resolute'' appeared during [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' film]]. To avoid unnecessary speculation regarding the ''Resolute''{{'s}} actions, this article assumes that ''Wild Space'' made a full [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]] of the ''Resolute'' and that it was not involved in the Battle of Christophsis. The ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' incorrectly states that the ''Resolute'' was involved in the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], while ''The Clone Wars'' novelization maintains that it was the ''[[Spirit of the Republic]]'', Yularen's original flagship, that was present at [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. This article goes with the latter's interpretation of events to avoid continuing the aforementioned issue. In multiple episodes of the television series, including "[[Jedi Crash]]," "[[Storm Over Ryloth]]," and "[[Children of the Force]]," the ''Resolute'' is incorrectly depicted without its red bridge markings. The same thing happens in ''[[The Clone Wars: The Wind Raiders of Taloraan]]''. The Resolute is the Main Hub on ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''. [[Star Wars (2013) 10|''Star Wars'' (2013) 10]] ([[October]] [[2013]]) mistakenly refers to the decommissioned ''[[Audacity]]''—another ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer from the time of the Clone
